author: Karl Rock
description:
Would you dare to explore one of Pakistan's most infamous black markets, where counterfeit PlayStations, vintage electronics and all sorts of bizarre goods are piled in crowded street stalls?

In this video, I head to Allah Wali Market in Karachi, Pakistan, a sprawling market locally known as Chor Bazaar, or the Thieves Market. Stretching for nearly a kilometre, this is no ordinary shopping destination. From mountains of second-hand electronics to unusual street stalls and unexpected discoveries, you never quite know what you'll find around the next corner.

Because of the market's reputation, I'm filming as discreetly as possible as I explore its crowded lanes and investigate what's for sale. The name Thieves Market doesn't mean everything sold here is stolen. However, the sheer variety of goods and their questionable origins raise interesting questions about the trade in second-hand merchandise and counterfeit products.

This video is a look at the market and its unusual character,
title: Undercover at Pakistan’s Largest Thieves Market
